title: Blur gate and token-separation test sample only router_mid; basic-tier puck measures 0.7deg from content_host under the same lens
evidence: tools/blur_gate.py:33 `SPAWNS = [` / :34 `    ("router_mid", 20, 15),` … :40 `    ("campus", 30, 10),` — no router_basic/router_high entry. app/render/palette_polish_test.odin:93-97: `anchors := [5]rl.Color{` / `p.small_biz_family, p.campus_family, p.residential_family,` / `p.host_family, p.router_tier_mid,` / `}` — router_tier_basic/high absent from the pairwise hue check.
detail: Measured on goldens/router_tiers/02500ms.png with the gate's own sigma-6 lens: router_basic hue 211.0deg vs content_host 210.3deg = 0.7deg (< 15deg bar); the gate stays GREEN because its sample table omits basic/high tiers entirely.

title: draw_family_wash rect paints family color onto canvas outside peaked/towered silhouettes
evidence: `draw_family_wash :: proc(v: ^View, dst: rl.Rectangle, fam: rl.Color) {` / `	if fam.a == 0 {` / `		return` / `	}` / `	w := dst.width * 0.92` / `	h := dst.height * 0.92` / `	rl.DrawRectangleV({dst.x + (dst.width - w) / 2, dst.y + (dst.height - h) / 2}, {w, h}, fam)` / `}` — axis-aligned fill over the full bbox; contrast view.odin:855 `// is a disc; a rect wash would square off its corners).`
detail: Buildings use the rect variant over non-rectangular footprints. Pixel-verified on goldens/terminal_types/05000ms.png at residential (8,15): gable-shoulder pixels read (211,118,113) = terracotta*0.8 over canvas — tinted corners square off the peaked silhouette.
recommended_fix: Make the building wash silhouette-aware (alpha-masked to the sprite, or per-role triangle/disc shapes like the puck variant) so family color never lands on canvas beside roofs/towers.

title: blur_gate.py setup errors exit 1 (gate-red) via traceback, not the documented exit 2; missing --sigma value silently ignored
evidence: `    path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "goldens/terminal_types/05000ms.png"` / `    sigma = 6` / `    out_path = None` / `    for i, a in enumerate(sys.argv[2:], start=2):` / `        if a == "--sigma" and i + 1 < len(sys.argv):` / `            sigma = float(sys.argv[i + 1])` — docstring: `Exit code 0 = gate green, 1 = gate red, 2 = usage/setup error.`
detail: Missing file (FileNotFoundError), non-numeric --sigma (ValueError), or out-of-range sample coords (IndexError) propagate as tracebacks exiting 1 — indistinguishable from a genuine gate failure; `--sigma` as last arg is silently dropped (sigma stays 6).
recommended_fix: Wrap path open, float(), and getpixel in try/except exiting 2 with a usage message; error on --sigma/--out given without a value.

evidence: ci-local.sh:16-17: `# gate list mirrors .github/workflows/ci.yml step-for-step — the workflow` / `# is the spec; never edit one without the other.` (no blur_gate reference in either). PR body: `tools/ci-local.sh` (linux container) — **10/10 gates green**:` / `lint/purity, core+app tests (219+), game build, golden harness (45 demos),` / `palcheck, drift-rejection, preview cross-check, PP_DEBUG builds, stats` / `replay-identity, input parity (27 scenarios).`
detail: Nothing runs tools/blur_gate.py automatically; future palette edits (wave-final reconciliation) could regress drawn hue separation with no CI signal — the token-level unit test covers only 5 of 7 new tokens.
